title: Penalty Fee Schedule — Northgate Card Late Payment and Returned Payment Fees
content:
The penalty fees on **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** are the same on all six cards: the Northgate Secured Card, Northgate Store Card, Northgate Mastercard, Northgate World Mastercard, Northgate Business Store Card and Northgate Business Mastercard.

| Fee figure | Every Northgate Card |
|---|---|
| Late payment fee for a first late payment | 32.00 USD |
| Late payment fee when another late payment occurred in any of the previous six billing cycles | 43.00 USD |
| Number of previous billing cycles searched for an earlier late payment to apply the repeat late fee | 6 |
| Ceiling on a late fee | never more than the minimum payment that was due |
| Returned payment fee for a first returned payment | 32.00 USD |
| Returned payment fee when another returned payment occurred in the previous six billing cycles | 43.00 USD |
| Number of late fees that may be reversed as a courtesy in any rolling 12 months | 1 |

**First and repeat amounts.** The first amount, 32.00 USD, and the repeat amount, 43.00 USD, are the same for a late payment fee and for a returned payment fee. The repeat amount turns on an earlier occurrence of the same kind within the previous six billing cycles.

**Ceiling.** The ceiling is the minimum payment that was due. Hypothetical illustration: where the minimum payment due was 25.00 USD, a late fee can be no more than 25.00 USD even though the first-late amount is 32.00 USD; where the minimum payment due was 60.00 USD, the full 32.00 USD or 43.00 USD fits under the ceiling.
